sentences.text:
Author: M.Satyanarayana Murthy
Bench: M.Satyanarayana Murthy
 The Honourable Sri Justice M.Satyanarayana Murthy
 Criminal Petition No.6054 of 2020
Order:

This criminal petition is filed under Section 482 Cr.P.C to quash the proceedings in crime No.129 of 2020 of Varikunta Padu Police Station, Sri Potti Sri Ramulu Nellore District, registered for the offences punishable under Sections 272, 273 and 328 read with Section 34 I.P.C. and Section 59(i)
of the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006.

entities.text: Varikunta Padu Police Station, Sri Potti Sri Ramulu Nellore District
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text:
2. Learned counsel for the petitioners and learned Public Prosecutor appearing for the respondent-State submit that the issue involved in this petition is squarely covered by the common order, dated 27.08.2018, passed by this Court in Crl.P.No.3731 of 2018 and batch.
3.

In view of the submission of learned counsel for the petitioners and learned Public Prosecutor appearing for the respondent-State, this Criminal Petition also stands allowed in terms of the aforesaid order.
As a sequel, all the pending miscellaneous applications shall stand closed.

Registry is directed to attach a copy of the common order, dated 27.08.2018, passed by this Court in Crl.P.No.3731 of 2018 and batch.
_____________________________ M.SATYANARAYANA MURTHY, J 24th December,
